name: Guangdong Southern New Media Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Southern New Media Co.,Ltd. provides internet audio-visual services in China. The company offers private network services; internet TV services, including internet TV integration platform and content service platform, as well as cloud audiovisual smart desktop, a TV desktop system for smart TVs, set-top boxes, and other smart terminals; and cable TV value-added services, such as research, development, and operation of cable TV networks and platforms that provide various contents comprising music, movie, e-sports, sport games, and children-related programs. It also engages in the industrial investment business, which include investment and fund management, consulting services, potential-exit channels, realization of upstream and downstream integration, and resource integration services, as well as capital, marketing, business, and talent operations; multimedia convergence cloud platform that supports the development of media convergence; and content copyright business. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
